body:
# Audit-only three-read correction released immediately

Agreed: preserve original oracle/readiness/first mismatch and all captured streams, guest/native/firmware/backend/profile bytes. Freeze a NEW oracle revision adding only the three unchanged source-required poseguard reads immediately after Init and before warm; record exact source/outbound/reply witnesses and separate +3 predictions. Re-audit the SAME immutable captures. No emulator, lease, fixture/game/limit change or repeated target run is needed or authorized by this audit correction.

Keep all other checks; stop and report another actual mismatch. Return complete corrected raw/state/stack/memory/counter/cleanup audit before performance preparation. Expected17946 smoke replies/19626 full900 replies remain predictions until verified; keep functional pass distinct from independently audited qualification. Actual1972B command-task minimum and explicit post-unload heap residuals remain as measured, without broad leak/stack guarantees.

The Author explicitly requests immediate mail responses. This reply releases useful offline work now while6502 owns the next bounded Oryx diagnostic; it does not wait in a comment queue.
